notes.title: UPDATE - Ver. 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Hello people!
I made a new update adding one more tool which would be AI(Artificial Intelligence) Speed, the speed changes who has the AI style mechanics.
[u][b]Why that?[/b][/u]
Well, not everyone has the same computer. On each computer model it can run fast and slow, some people have already complained about enemy speed because his speed was normal on mine and on others super fast. So I put slow mode and I noticed a youtuber said that the enemy was very slow.
It came to my mind "If I create a speed mechanic inside the configuration will it work?"
I did that and lucky I had previous annotation of the old speed. players can choose the speed of the AI.

notes.title: Bugs were fixed, but I used plan "A"
notes.notes:
Hello people.
I spent 4 days correcting and looking for a solution to the problem that you guys gave me, I discovered something that is the version of unreal I was using was 4.14. With this version it was not possible to make a big game, but a very small game running (It would be very strange).
And I had warned you before in the previous post, so... I used plan "A" and it worked!
Of course when I changed to 4.26 the mechanics change and I have to update it until it works 100%, not only the mechanics... I put the texture (unreal put it of course without texture) and updated the images.

This is good news, but... This game will only run on 64bit computers. Sorry... ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Fixing the bugs!
notes.notes:
I'm fixing the bugs that were very weird, when I had little phase the game worked normally. Then it became a full game, the bugs appeared meaningless and it didn't work properly.

There may be two things that can be resolved if I can't:
A- Change the Unreal version to 4.26, but you can only play when you are on a 64bit computer
B- Recreate the game in version 4.14.

The deadline for the new update has no date, but the game will keep updating non-stop until it is 100% correct.
